description: Keep Service fixed at the stable equal-third level and make one small, symmetric shift between Throughput and Jain fairness. This round tests whether the stable region can be improved without repeating the 0.50-heavy collapses from Round 05.

common.reward_normalization: Use the same bounded Throughput, Jain fairness and Service scores as prior rounds. Keep Service fixed at 1/3 because the equal-third baseline was the only stable three-component policy and Service-heavy collapsed. Move only 0.0666667 weight between Throughput and Jain. All undeclared rewards, penalties, reward deltas and Lagrangian multipliers remain disabled.

cases.label: Mild throughput tilt: 40% throughput, 26.67% Jain, 33.33% service
cases.hypothesis: With Service held at the stable shaping level, does a small shift from Jain to Throughput improve goodput without causing the coverage collapse seen at 50% Throughput?

cases.label: Mild Jain tilt: 26.67% throughput, 40% Jain, 33.33% service
cases.hypothesis: With Service held at the stable shaping level, does a small shift from Throughput to Jain improve deterministic fairness without creating the flat-priority behavior seen at 50% Jain?
